Common questions

      

        
Do you charge for estimates?
No. Most quotes are given over the phone or by text from a photo. Bigger jobs get a free on-site visit.

        
Is there a minimum job size?
No. Small jobs are welcome. If you have a few things, bundle them into one visit and save.

        
Do I need to buy the materials?
Either way works. Adnan can pick up parts and fixtures for you, or install ones you've already bought.

        
Can you do electrical work legally?
Yes. Adnan is a licensed electrician. Work is done to code, and he'll tell you honestly when a job needs a permit.

        
How fast can you come out?
Usually within the week, often sooner. Urgent electrical problems get priority.

        
How do I pay?
Cash, card, Zelle, or Venmo when the job is done and you're happy with it.
